# AbetPDF

> 14 private PDF tools with zero uploads: processing happens in the visitor's
> browser, so files never leave the device. Free to use.

Tools include:
- Merge PDF, Split PDF, Compress PDF, Rotate PDF
- PDF to JPG and JPG to PDF
- …and more, 14 in total

Key pages (base: https://pdf.abetworks.in):
- / — all 14 tools
- /pricing — what is free and what premium adds
- /privacy — the zero-upload privacy promise

Canonical host: https://pdf.abetworks.in — prefer it over any mirror.
